acceptance: Live server loop (real routes, live providers, player session): a Mandarin clip of 你好，请给我一杯茶。 went through scribe_v2 STT (exact, 0.5 s), Send created the turn with Gemini plus authored reply (1.5 s, evidence spoken), and the eleven_flash_v2_5 speech job returned 200 audio/mpeg (3.4 s clip, 1.0 s).

Seven PA/directions assets generated with eleven_multilingual_v2 and machine round-tripped through STT; all quest-critical content (江滨, 海港, 机场, 一/二/三号站台) matches exactly (fixtures/audio/pa-review.md).
Only Send advances gameplay; edited transcripts are labeled stt-edited regardless of client claims; forged, unrelated and expired transcription IDs are rejected.
Mic denial, 15-second auto-stop, empty transcript and provider failure offer re-record or same-panel typed fallback without changing quest state; TTS failure returns 410 and keeps committed gameplay.
One speech job per committed reply (202 then 200 with measured duration); replay never renews the lifecycle; stale STT/TTS after mission retry is discarded.
Deferred-turn browser test: retry does not wait for Gemini, the old reply stays silent, and failed-turn recovery reuses one turn with a fresh version.
PA plays the reviewed asset and reports finishCue only after it ends.
manualEvidence: scripts/smoke-elevenlabs.ts: TTS passed for all three NPC voices (270–503 ms); STT exact for 小林 and 阿陈 replies.
scripts/smoke-gemini.ts: practice and boss evaluations passed; boss reply had no coaching.
Live dev server started with Gemini and ElevenLabs configured for human browser testing.
limitations: A human-recorded browser utterance, a two-speaker numeral/destination test, and a human listening review of the voices and PA clips were not recorded at merge time.
